dedupe_keys.name: donnees climatiques prospectives france 4 c vague de chaleur

description: ADEME publishes prospective climate data for metropolitan France under the +4°C heatwave scenario. The source explicitly identifies applications to building energy consumption, carbon impact and indoor thermal conditions, with the purpose of adapting buildings and local communities to climate change. The files are derived from CNRM-AROME climate simulations and contain hourly series for 17 climatic and astronomical parameters across eight reference climate zones in metropolitan France. The stated warming levels are relative to the pre-industrial period 1850–1900. ADEME describes the wider collection as containing +2°C, +2.7°C and +4°C climates and heatwave episodes; this native dataset represents the +4°C heatwave member. The source states that the prospective files complement current RE2020 weather information and are non-regulatory. Météo-France, CSTB and DHUP are named in the production context. The metadata lists an ADEME dataset page and a CSV distribution under an Open Licence. CSV rows, time-axis construction and building-level performance results have not been inspected. A limitation is that these are scenarios, not validated building-specific predictions.
